title: Corelle set gray
text: Corelle set gray. I moved away from the extra heavy ironstone ceramic ware and to Corelle.  I have purchased several different patterns... but I really loved the subtle, soft gray of this set. The gray is soft and I would say SLIGHTLY taupe gray - so less blue gray, very slightly brown gray - in case that is super important to you.  Looks great with the frost white pieces I have.  What is the greatest thing about Corelle... several things... lightweight, but nearly unbreakable (they WILL break - but you gotta really hit it just right or try super hard)... takes up very little space because they are thin.  REALLY easy to load and unload into and out of the dishwasher.  There is a pattern and a color for everyone.  The older I get, the easier I like things.  I will say that you will want to invest in some plate hotpads.  One of the side effects of a thinner plate, it transfers heat really quickly.  Small price to pay for such ease of use.

product_metadata.title: Corelle 18-Piece Dinnerware Set, Service for 6, Lightweight Round Plates and Bowls Set, Vitrelle Triple Layer Glass, Chip Resistant, Microwave and Dishwasher Safe, Caspian
features: 18-PIECE SET: This set has everything you need for a full table service of 6. Includes (6) 10.25-inch dinner plates, (6) 6.75-inch appetizer plates and (6) 18-oz soup/cereal bowls.

VITRELLE STRONG: Featuring triple-layer-strong glass plates and bowls making them resistant to chips, cracks, and scratches. This durable dinnerware set is lightweight, easy to handle, and allows for compact stacking, maximizing your cabinet space.

EASY-TO-CLEAN: This dinnerware set is designed to provide the best dining experience while being ultra-hygienic, non-porous and easy to clean. Plates and bowls are dishwasher safe, freezer safe, and microwave safe.

CLASSIC STYLE: Crisp cottage textiles with delicate scalloped trim brings a gentle charm to this dinnerware set. Dishes in clean white with navy detailing feel airy and relaxed, and the perfect color palette for any setting.
TIMELESS BEAUTY: Crafted with pride in Corning, New York, Corelle Dinnerware are a staple of modern eating for everyday occasions, filling hearts and tables since 1970.
